title: QUIZ - 85
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.concept: Evaluating Quadratics with Negative Inputs
questions.learningObjective: Evaluate a quadratic function carefully at a negative input value
questions.question: Evaluate \( f(t) = 5t^2 + -12 \) when t = -1. (Be careful with the sign when squaring.)
questions.explanation: Squaring a negative input gives a positive result: (-1)^2 = 1. So 5(1) + -12 = -7.
questions.hint: Remember that squaring a negative number always produces a positive result.

questions.hint: Square the input value first, then multiply by the leading coefficient.
